intro: Fraggar Thundermantle, a Wildhammer, has already taken troll tribal necklaces from you once under this bounty. The offer stands for more, as long as you bring them five at a time.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You've done it already, but we will continue to accept any troll tribal necklaces you find and are willing to turn in. By turning them in to me, you'll continue to improve your standing amongst the Wildhammers; if you're willing to fight for us, then we'll be willing to fight for you!
I need five troll tribal necklaces for them to count, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now that's what I am talking about! See - these necklaces prove that you're willing to get your hands dirty. We Wildhammers value that in those we associate with.
You keep this up, and you'll be in our good graces yet.
